chains.rationale: At the reuse target, the agent repeats the false premise that the LinkedIn email is already open and performs another ineffective drag on the inbox. summary: The reused false-success premise produced one further ineffective inbox scroll before the agent opened the LinkedIn email; the required email to Kevin is not visibly sent in the supplied trace.
